name: LifterLMS
summary: WordPress plugin for building and selling online courses and memberships, with a free open-source core and paid add-ons for payments, email marketing, quizzes and groups.
best_for: course creators and training businesses already on WordPress who want to own their course site and pay a yearly licence instead of a monthly platform fee
skip_if: you do not want to run WordPress yourself, or you want a hosted course platform where hosting and updates are handled for you
honest_knock: Taking payments needs a paid bundle, and every bundle renews at twice the first-year price: Earth $398, Universe $598 and Infinity $1,598 a year. LifterLMS is a WordPress plugin, so hosting, updates, backups and theme compatibility are yours to manage. Earth covers one site and one support user. We have not used LifterLMS ourselves.

pricing.notes: (re-read 2026-11-22 on lifterlms.com/pricing: the normal prices of $398, $598 and $1,598 a year are unchanged. Through November the page runs a Black Friday sale in place of the usual first-year offer: 60% off the first year with the code BLACKFRIDAY26, so year one shows $159.20 for Earth, $239.20 for Universe and $639.20 for Infinity, and renewals stay at full price. The FAQ still describes the standing 50% first-year discount. The sale is temporary and not the list price.) (read 2026-10-10 on lifterlms.com/pricing, USD) The LifterLMS core plugin for WordPress is free and open source, with unlimited courses, memberships, students and teachers. Paid bundles are annual subscriptions, shown at an introductory 50% off the first year with the code FIRSTYEAR50, and the page states that all renewals are at full price. Earth is $199 for the first year, normally $398: 1 active site, support for 1 user, the Stripe, PayPal and WooCommerce e-commerce add-ons, cart abandonment recovery and name-your-price. Universe, marked most popular, is $299 for the first year, normally $598: 5 active sites, support for 2 users, the Sky Pilot theme, 4 e-commerce add-ons, email marketing and CRM add-ons (including Mailchimp and Kit), form integrations (Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms, WPForms) and a weekly mastermind with a private Facebook group. Infinity is $799 for the first year, normally $1,598: unlimited sites, support for 3 users and 15 advanced add-ons such as advanced quizzes and videos, assignments, groups, private areas, a private site and social learning. A lifetime Infinity licence is offered on a separate page. A 30-day demo site with every add-on costs $1, and purchases carry a 30-day, 100% money-back guarantee with no setup fees. Licences renew automatically; you can cancel the renewal at any time.

sessions.what: Our AI assistant ran the test on 22 November 2026 in WordPress Playground, a temporary WordPress site that runs in the browser, with the free LifterLMS core plugin from WordPress.org and the interface in English. We went through the setup wizard, built a course with a lesson in the Course Builder, added a free access plan, enrolled through the course page and marked the lesson complete. We paid nothing and opened the Earth checkout only to read the price.
findings: Setup: no LifterLMS account is needed. The wizard created the course catalog, checkout and student dashboard pages, and its payments step said you need to install a payment gateway to accept online payments. A later step offered a coupon in exchange for sharing usage data; we said no.
Course Builder: our new course opened with one section and three empty lessons. We renamed one, added text and saved; a quiz could be added from the same panel.
Access plans: the free plugin offered free, monthly, annual, one time, lifetime, paid trial, hidden and pre-sale plans. Gift purchases, group access and name your price were marked as add ons.
Enrolling: even for the free plan, the default checkout asked for first and last name, address, city, state and ZIP code. After we filled in made up values it showed Course enrollment success!
Progress: Mark Complete on the lesson showed You Completed a Lesson and course progress of 33.33%.

Checkout: on 22 November 2026, in the November sale with code BLACKFRIDAY26, Earth was $159.20 for the first year for one site (normally $398) with the Stripe, PayPal and WooCommerce add ons; Universe was $239.20 for five sites. Renewals are at full price. The checkout asked for an email, name, country and ZIP code, a card or PayPal, and agreement to the terms. We did not pay.
